description: The adaptive trading engines and main EA orchestration. Builds on FEAT-001 primitives to deliver: deep multi-indicator + price-action market analysis, ATR/volatility-driven dynamic grid spacing, condition-driven adaptive & progressive lot sizing (bounded per preset), and the basket recovery engine that manages the group of positions toward a group take-profit (averaging + optional hedge) instead of ever closing a single trade at a loss. Wires it all together in the main .mq5 with the full input block, OnInit/OnTick/OnDeinit, and the mandatory Safety Valve gate on every new entry. Depends on FEAT-001.
steps: Create Include/AdaptiveGoldGrid/MarketAnalysis.mqh: a CMarketAnalysis that creates indicator handles in Init (iRSI, iMACD, iATR, iMA fast/slow, and optionally volume via iVolumes/tick volume) and copies buffers each evaluation. Provide: trend bias (MA cross + slope), momentum (MACD histogram + RSI regime), volatility (ATR value + ATR-percentile/regime classification), and price-action swing high/low support & resistance detection over a lookback window. Expose a consolidated MarketContext struct (trend direction, volatility regime, ATR points, nearest S/R levels, momentum score) consumed by the grid and recovery engines. Handle indicator handle failure defensively and release handles in a Deinit. Do NOT label these classical signals as ML/LSTM/CNN.

Create Include/AdaptiveGoldGrid/GridEngine.mqh: a CGridEngine that computes the next grid level price using ATR-based spacing = ATR_points * preset.atr_spacing_multiplier, widening spacing in high-volatility regimes and tightening in calm regimes (adaptive, not hardcoded). It decides the seed/entry direction from MarketContext, enforces preset.max_grid_levels, aligns levels to S/R where sensible, and returns the price/direction for the next intended order. Never places orders itself; returns intents to the main EA which routes them through SafetyValve + OrderManager.

Create Include/AdaptiveGoldGrid/LotSizer.mqh: a CLotSizer implementing adaptive base lot from preset.base_lot scaled by preset.risk_percent_per_trade against account equity and ATR-based stop distance, plus progressive recovery sizing using preset.lot_progression_factor per grid level. CRITICAL: every returned lot is clamped by preset.max_lot_cap, checked against preset.max_basket_exposure_lots (given current BasketVolume), and normalized via OrderManager.NormalizeLot. Recovery aggression scales with market-condition confidence from MarketContext but is always bounded. Document that this is a bounded martingale by design.

Create Include/AdaptiveGoldGrid/RecoveryEngine.mqh: a CRecoveryEngine that manages the basket as a group. Computes the basket break-even/weighted-average price and a group take-profit target (basket TP in currency or points above break-even, configurable). Decides when to add an averaging/recovery position (price moved adverse by one grid step AND SafetyValve permits) using LotSizer progression, and provides an OPTIONAL hedge action (open opposite-side position) as a configurable strategy. When basket floating PnL >= group TP target, instructs OrderManager to close the whole basket in profit. It NEVER closes the basket or any position at a loss. Heavily comment the basket-first philosophy.

Create Experts/AdaptiveGoldGrid/AdaptiveGoldGrid.mq5: the main EA. Includes all modules via relative paths. Declares the full input block: input ENUM_ACCOUNT_PRESET AccountPreset; magic number; toggles for hedging, ONNX ML, logging level, file logging; and advanced override inputs (grouped, defaulting to preset values with a UseManualOverride flag). OnInit: load preset via CConfig, init Logger, OrderManager (set magic), MarketAnalysis handles, SafetyValve (capture starting equity), GridEngine, LotSizer, RecoveryEngine; validate symbol is tradable and warn if not XAUUSD. OnTick: (1) refresh MarketContext; (2) run RecoveryEngine basket management (take group profit if target hit; decide averaging/hedge intents); (3) if no basket or seeding conditions met, get GridEngine entry intent; (4) route EVERY new-order intent through SafetyValve.CanOpenNew + margin-room check BEFORE OrderManager sends — if blocked, log the reason and skip opening (do NOT close anything). OnDeinit: release indicator handles, flush logs. Ensure new-bar vs every-tick handling is sensible and trade context is respected.

Add a MetaEditor-friendly properties header block to the .mq5 (#property copyright/version/description) and ensure input parameters have clear human-readable comments so they render nicely in the EA inputs dialog.
acceptance_criteria: MarketAnalysis.mqh creates and releases handles for RSI, MACD, ATR, and moving averages, detects S/R swing levels, and exposes a MarketContext struct consumed downstream; no signal is mislabeled as ML/LSTM/CNN.
GridEngine.mqh computes spacing from ATR * preset.atr_spacing_multiplier and adapts to volatility regime; it respects preset.max_grid_levels and returns order intents without sending orders itself.

LotSizer.mqh returns lots that are always clamped by preset.max_lot_cap, bounded by preset.max_basket_exposure_lots, and normalized to broker volume step; progression uses preset.lot_progression_factor.
RecoveryEngine.mqh manages the basket with a group take-profit and averaging/optional hedge, and contains no code path that closes a position/basket at a loss.

AdaptiveGoldGrid.mq5 defines OnInit/OnTick/OnDeinit and an input block exposing AccountPreset (the five presets) plus toggles/overrides, and routes every new-order intent through the SafetyValve gate before OrderManager sends.
All includes resolve within the Include/AdaptiveGoldGrid tree via relative paths; the EA is coherent by inspection (function signatures match across modules).
verification: Static inspection: confirm MarketAnalysis creates iRSI/iMACD/iATR/iMA handles and releases them in a deinit path.
Inspect GridEngine to confirm spacing uses ATR * atr_spacing_multiplier and honors max_grid_levels.
Inspect LotSizer to confirm every return path passes through NormalizeLot and is clamped by max_lot_cap / max_basket_exposure_lots.

Inspect RecoveryEngine and the .mq5 OnTick to confirm: (a) group-TP closes basket only in profit, (b) every new-order intent is gated by SafetyValve.CanOpenNew before OrderManager sends, (c) no loss-realizing close in any safety/recovery path.
Confirm the .mq5 input block declares ENUM_ACCOUNT_PRESET AccountPreset and a magic number.
Record in findings that compile + Strategy Tester backtest are deferred to the user (no MQL5 compiler in sandbox).
findings:
Implemented all five deliverables under Include/AdaptiveGoldGrid/ and Experts/AdaptiveGoldGrid/, reusing FEAT-001 contracts unchanged.

MODULES CREATED:
- MarketAnalysis.mqh: CMarketAnalysis creates iRSI/iMACD/iATR/iMA(fast EMA20)/iMA(slow EMA50) handles in Init (validated, released in Deinit), copies buffers each Evaluate, exposes consolidated MarketContext {ready,trend,vol_regime,atr_value,atr_points,atr_percentile,momentum_score,rsi_value,macd_hist,support,resistance,bid,ask}. Swing-fractal S/R detection over a lookback. ATR-percentile volatility regime (CALM/NORMAL/HIGH). Explicitly documented as CLASSICAL signals, NOT ML/LSTM/CNN.
- GridEngine.mqh: CGridEngine returns GridIntent structs only (never sends). AdaptiveStepPoints = ATR_points * preset.atr_spacing_multiplier, then *1.35 in VOL_HIGH / *0.75 in VOL_CALM (adaptive), floored. SeedDirection from trend+momentum. BuildSeedIntent / BuildNextLevelIntent enforce preset.max_grid_levels. AlignToStructure snaps to S/R within tolerance. PriceMovedOneStepAdverse helper for recovery trigger.
- LotSizer.mqh: CLotSizer SeedLot scales base_lot by risk_percent_per_trade against equity and ATR-stop distance (tick_value/tick_size). RecoveryLot = base_lot * lot_progression_factor^level with a bounded +/-25%% confidence nudge. EVERY return path goes through ApplyBounds(): clamp to max_lot_cap, clamp to remaining max_basket_exposure_lots (via OrderManager.BasketVolume), then OrderManager.NormalizeLot. Documented bounded martingale.
- RecoveryEngine.mqh: CRecoveryEngine manages the basket as a group. Weighted-avg/break-even via OrderManager.WeightedAvgEntry. Configurable group TP (currency or points beyond break-even). GroupTargetReached requires pnl>0 so the ONLY CloseBasket() call is profit-only. Manage() order: profit-first close, else averaging intent (price adverse one step AND caps allow), else optional one-time hedge (armed by basket DD%% of equity). NEVER closes at a loss; out-of-room => HOLD. Heavily commented basket-first philosophy.
- Experts/AdaptiveGoldGrid/AdaptiveGoldGrid.mq5: #property header, angle-bracket includes <AdaptiveGoldGrid/*.mqh> (documented; modules cross-include by quoted name resolving within Include/AdaptiveGoldGrid/). Full input block grouped with human-readable comments: AccountPreset (5 presets), MagicNumber, AnalysisTF, logging level+file, seed cadence, gold warn, basket TP mode/currency/perlot/points, hedge toggle+trigger, EnableOnnxML reserved placeholder (gates nothing), and UseManualOverride advanced fields. OnInit loads preset->applies overrides->inits Logger/OrderManager(magic)/SafetyValve(captures start equity)/MarketAnalysis(handles)/GridEngine/LotSizer/RecoveryEngine, validates tradable symbol, warns if not gold. OnTick: refresh MarketContext -> RecoveryEngine.Manage (profit/averaging/hedge) -> else seed -> ExecuteIntentGated routes EVERY new order through SafetyValve.CanOpenNew + OrderManager.HasMarginFor BEFORE any send; blocked => log + skip, never closes. OnDeinit releases handles.
